questions.prompt: To open the portal to the Secret Cow Level, what two items are transmuted in the Horadric Cube?
choices: Wirt's Leg + Tome of Town Portal
Horadric Staff + Tome of Town Portal
Khalim's Will + Tome of Town Portal
questions.explanation: In the Rogue Encampment after finishing that difficulty, cube Wirt's Leg plus a Tome of Town Portal to tear open the red portal.

questions.prompt: The Cow King is a Super Unique of which monster type?
questions.explanation: The Cow King is a Hell Bovine carrying Magic Resistant and Lightning Enchanted modifiers.

questions.prompt: What happens once a character slays The Cow King on a difficulty?
choices: The portal spawns a harder cow king
The character can never reopen the Cow Level portal on that difficulty
All cows drop a rune on the next kill
questions.explanation: Killing the Cow King on a difficulty permanently seals the portal for that character; no more cow runs on that difficulty.
